# Taisiia Fedorova

> Full-stack developer and UX/UI designer in Kyiv, Ukraine, who designs and builds web applications end to end, from the data layer to the last state of a hover.

## Role

- Full-stack developer and UX/UI designer
- High school student in Kyiv, studying full-stack development through GoIT
- React and TypeScript on the front end, Python and Flask on the back end
- Open to internships and collaboration

## Projects

- [RepoLens](https://github.com/Ta1siia/repository-lens): renders a public GitHub repository's commit history as an interactive graph, where file size tracks how often a file changes and edges connect files that consistently change together. Clicking a file shows its recent commits with an AI-generated summary. Python, Flask, SQLite, D3.js, Gemini API. Live, 2026. [Demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cJgl__tbH_c).
